about.heading: Passionate CS Student & Multi-Domain Professional
paragraphs: I am Jit Das, a passionate and driven Computer Science student at Techno India University, West Bengal, dedicated to building innovative and impactful digital solutions. With hands-on experience in full-stack web development, I work across the spectrum — from crafting responsive frontends with React to architecting robust backends with Node.js and Python.

My recent project, ESD (Environmental Sustainability Dashboard), reflects my ability to take an idea from concept to completion — combining research, design, and development into a cohesive real-world solution. I thrive at the intersection of technology and problem-solving, bringing dedication, curiosity, and a growth mindset to everything I do.

At EpochFolio I rose through multiple roles including Hiring Manager and Client Delivery Head, leading 45 TA executives to a 93% placement rate. At iMerit Technology I joined Fortune 500 AI annotation pipelines as the youngest developer on team.
